description: Lists the elements of one category whose parameter matches a rule (equals, contains, greater than, has a value, ...). The rule runs inside Revit as an ElementParameterFilter.

params.description: Category name, for example Walls or OST_Doors.
params.name: category

params.description: BuiltInParameter name (ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS) or a project or shared parameter name.
params.name: parameter

params.description: Value to compare with, as text.
params.name: value

params.description: How to read value: text, number (a length, area or other double) or integer.
params.name: value_type

params.description: Unit of a number value: internal (feet, square feet, ...), mm, cm, m, ft, in, m2, ft2, m3, ft3, deg or rad.
params.name: unit

title: Elements by parameter rule
